She doesn’t get upset in most things and clearly doesn’t give a damn in most situations, especially in school since she hates that place. A lot of times, however, she gets gassy so much that she farts a lot without any care. She would fart anywhere at any time, even around people. She’ll even fart with her bestie since she also tends to be gassy as well. Sometimes, she’ll hunt down her next target to be a fart smeller for fun. She does like to torture her victim by smelling her stinky fart directly from her ass. Even Lizz would torture her victims with Rebecca for fun too. Why does she fart a lot? It’s just the way she is. No matter what she eats, she’ll be as gassy as ever. It’s no wonder why she's failed a few times, other than not being in class on time or failing to do work. She’ll even use her gas as her weapon whoever dares to mock her or mess with her, or mess with her bestie. Overall, she’s sexy and chill, but very gassy obviously.
Fart intensity: Most of the time, her farts are short, but very loud, and she’ll continuously push out one after another. Even with her sexy rump, it’s a very dangerous thing to be around when she’s gassy, but for her, she likes to be this gassy around others because she feels sexier whenever there’s people around to smell her, even if they have disgusted reactions. Anyway, her fart smell is a mix of rotten eggs, spoiled milk, cheese, and dirty clothes that haven't been washed for a long time. The sound is averagely over 100 decibels, which is obviously very loud and can be heard over a mile away. Even if she farts in school, it can be heard in the entire building, even outside of it. So…not only she’ll burn your nose, but may hurt your ears too…
Fun Fact: Whenever she fails at school, her bestie fails with her.
